description: Hard-delete the agent_role_binding state-table row for the named role. Used when a session deliberately vacates a role — operator runs /rename to a different label, the session shuts down cleanly, or the role is reassigned to a new session via a different /rename. v10 Control #2 made agent_role_binding the sole resolution authority, so the release is a HARD delete (soft_delete=False is required — a soft delete would still resolve and enumerate, i.e. not release at all). After release, subsequent peer_send_by_name calls return peer_role_vacant until a new session claims the role; the one-shot backfill marker (Control #2 B5) prevents a released role from being re-seeded on a later boot.
embedding_description: Release a durable peer role binding, removing the row that routes role-addressed messages for names like Coordinator, Architect, or Git-Controller. Used when a session vacates its role on clean shutdown, an operator rename, or a handoff. Role-addressed sends then report the role vacant until someone claims it again.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: released (True on a completed hard-delete), name (the role). The delete is keyed on external_id='role:{name}' with soft_delete=False, so the row is gone — a subsequent peer_send_by_name returns peer_role_vacant.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the release; the operator-facing identifier is the name. After release, the role resolves as vacant until re-claimed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Hard-deletes the agent_role_binding state-table row (keyed on external_id='role:{name}', soft_delete=False) that backs peer_send_by_name resolution. Deletes via the StateManagementInterface (delete_records); no address book.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_name: name was empty. state_service_unavailable: the state_service is not bound on this solet.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: missing_name: supply a non-empty role name. state_service_unavailable: bind the state_service (postgres_state_management_plugin) in service_bindings.json and restart.
